text:
Maria (RevOps): FYI — we're seeing a lot of ownership churn when enrichment takes longer than ~12s. Leads get assigned, then re-assigned after enrichment completes. Thinking we should debounce the ownership signal for a short window (30s?) so the RR/fallback logic only runs once.
Sam (Growth): +1. Can you quantify how many leads this affects per hour?
Maria (RevOps): Roughly 120 leads/hr during peak yesterday; ~8% reassign within 60s. Will pull exact numbers.
Kevin (Sales Eng): Is this happening because HubSpot is writing owner before enrichment field is populated, or because the sync to SF fires a second assignment?
Maria (RevOps): Mostly HS writes owner on ingest (default fallback). Then enrichment webhook updates contact, triggering our assign workflow again.
Jess (Marketing Ops): Oof. That explains the noisy notifications and mistaken "new lead" pings in sales ops.
Alex (Eng-Data): Quick thought — add a short TTL on the owner_claim event: if last_claim < now - 30s skip. That keeps logic simple and local to the routing lambda.
Maria (RevOps): Exactly. POC logic below:
```
# pseudo-workflow / routing lambda
if lead.enrichment_status == 'pending' and now - lead.ingest_ts < 30:
    hold_assignment('wait_for_enrichment')
else:
    assign_via_round_robin(lead.pool)
```
Sam (Growth): 30s seems sensible as a default, but maybe make it configurable per pool (VIP pools shorter).
Kevin (Sales Eng): Agree — VIP fast lane should still be max 8s. Non-VIP 30s. Also we should avoid putting leads into unowned queue during debounce.
Maria (RevOps): Plan: implement debounce window + an observability tag so we can query how many leads are delayed by it. Need a metric: `lead.ownership_debounce.count` with tags pool, env
Alex (Eng-Data): I'll add a datapoint from the routing service and a simple SQL metric:
```sql
SELECT count(*) as debounce_hits, pool
FROM lead_events
WHERE event = 'debounce_hold' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
GROUP BY pool;
```
Jess (Marketing Ops): Can we also wire a lightweight HS property `rd_ownership_hold` true/false so reps don't get notified twice?
Maria (RevOps): Yes — set `rd_ownership_hold=true` on hold, clear on assign. hs-sync-bot will pick that up.
hs-sync-bot: Noted — will ignore events where `rd_ownership_hold=true` to avoid double-sync.
Kevin (Sales Eng): Rollout strategy? Canary 10% of ingest, monitor debounce_hits, reassignment_rate, and SLA (time-to-first-assign). Also watch for edge case: enrichment never completes -> end up unassigned after TTL. We need a fallback TTL to force assign to overflow pool after 10m.
Maria (RevOps): Suggested rollout: stage -> 10% canary for 24h -> 50% -> 100%. I'll own rollout and docs.
Alex (Eng-Data): I'll add dashboards: debounce_hits, reassignment_rate_60s, avg_enrichment_latency, assigned_after_hold_count. Also a Grafana alert if reassignment_rate_60s > 5% or debounce_hits > 500/hr.
Jess (Marketing Ops): Can we add a small message to sales slack when a VIP lead is held: "VIP lead held for enrichment (ETA 30s)" so AE knows to expect a brief wait? Not a full notification, just a subtle note.
Sam (Growth): Good UX idea. Maybe only for VIP and Enterprise pools.
Maria (RevOps): Action items: 1) Alex to add metrics and alert (ETA EOD) 2) Eng to add debounce flag & default 30s, configurable per pool (Alex + Eng) (ETA 2d) 3) Maria to prepare rollout doc + HS property change (ETA tomorrow) 4) Jess to draft messaging for AE slack (ETA tomorrow morning).
Kevin (Sales Eng): One more ask — please capture the original owner in a `previous_owner` field when reassign happens so we can audit churn.
Maria (RevOps): Yes — we'll write previous_owner and a `debounce_reason` metadata blob.
Alex (Eng-Data): I'll also instrument a one-off job to backfill `debounce_hits` for last 7 days so we can compare.
Jess (Marketing Ops): Thanks — this should clean up a lot of noise. :pray:
Sam (Growth): Thumbs up. LMK if you want me to pull the Q/A for the AE webinar about lead delivery SLA — this is a great talking point about reliability.
Maria (RevOps): Will do. I'll post the rollout checklist in #marketing-release when ready.
Kevin (Sales Eng): Sounds good. If we run into surprises, we can short-circuit and reduce window.
Maria (RevOps): Cool — meeting adjourned. I'll follow up with the doc and the canary link.
